findings.motion: Request for Attorney General official opinion on the voter identification requirement (Miss. Code 23-15-563)
findings.note: The opinion letter says it answers his request for an official opinion. Per the letter, he asked what forms of ID a voter may show at the polls after the 2024 amendment of Section 23-15-563. His five questions cover expired driver's licenses, IDs from other states, an expired gun permit, and IDs from other countries. The letter text is the Attorney General's, not his; the questions are as presented in that letter.
